summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests belantamab mafodotin given with cyclophosphamide, bortezomib, and dexamethasone in adults with newly diagnosed AL amyloidosis. How the drugs are given, and how often or for how long, is not stated; the study has a dose optimization phase, in which participants receive one of two belantamab mafodotin dose levels, and a dose expansion phase. The main outcome is not stated; the record says the study aims to evaluate efficacy and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa belantamab mafodotina administrada junto con ciclofosfamida, bortezomib y dexametasona en adultos con amiloidosis AL recién diagnosticada. La vía de administración y la frecuencia o duración del tratamiento no se indican; el estudio tiene una fase de optimización de dosis, en la que los participantes reciben uno de dos niveles de dosis de belantamab mafodotina, y una fase de expansión de dosis. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro señala que el objetivo es evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with newly diagnosed AL amyloidosis.
Histologically confirmed AL amyloidosis with an amyloid-related systemic syndrome.
Measurable clonal disease based on serum monoclonal protein or free light chain levels.
Not a candidate for high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant as first-line therapy.
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2, with adequate blood, liver, and kidney function.
not_for: Symptomatic multiple myeloma, POEMS syndrome, or IgM-related AL amyloidosis.
Any non-AL amyloidosis, including transthyretin amyloidosis.
NYHA class IIIb or IV heart failure, or clinically significant untreated arrhythmia.
Prior therapy for AL amyloidosis or multiple myeloma, other than limited corticosteroid exposure.
Previous or current malignancy other than AL amyloidosis, unless considered medically stable for at least 2 years.
